questions.q: 10. The average of a set of 20 consecutive integers is 25.5. What is the smallest integer in the set?
questions.s:
10.(a)

According to the question,

Sum total of 20 consecutive integers = 25.5 × 20 = 510

Let the first integer = x

So, 510 = x + (x +1) + (x + 2) + (x + 3) + ……….+ (x + 19)

510 = 20x + [1 + 2 + 3 + ……+ 19]

510 = 20x + [192(1 + 19)]

510 = 20x + [192(20)]

510 = 20x + 190

20x = 320

x = 16

So, smallest integer = 16

questions.q: 10. Find the value of 3k3+4 such that the 6-digit number 310k0k is divisible by 6.
questions.s:
10.(c) For 310k0k to be divisible by 6, the number must be divisible by 2 and 3.

For 310k0k to be divisible by 2, the unit digit must be 0, 2, 4, 6, 8.

For 310k0k to be divisible by 3, the sum of digits of a given number must be divisible by 3.

Putting k = 0, 2, 4, 6, 8 we find that k = 4 satisfies the required conditions. Hence k = 4.

Now,  3k3+4=3(4)3+4 =192+4=196 = 14

questions.q: 4. How many factors of the number 21600 are perfect squares?
questions.s:
4.(a) Prime factors of 21600 = 52×25×33  ⇒(52×24×32 )×(2×3)
Now, we have to take only even powered factors to find the perfect square factors,
⇒52 ×24×32 = (52)1 ×(22)2 ×(32)1
So, the number of factors for this part = (1+1)×(2+1)×(1+1) = 2×3×2 = 12
i.e. 12 factors of the number 21600 are perfect squares.

questions.q: 8. 2 biscuits and 1 chocolate cost ₹69. 2 chocolates and 3 cups of coffee cost ₹127. 3 biscuits, 4 chocolates and 2 cups of coffee cost ₹229. Find the total cost (in ₹) of 5 biscuits, 5 chocolates and 5 cups of coffee.
questions.s:
8.(d)
Let cost of 1 biscuit, 1 chocolate, 1 cup coffee be x, y, z respectively.
According to question,
2x + y = 69 … (i)
2y + 3z = 127… (ii)
3x + 4y + 2z = 229… (iii)
Adding (i) and (iii)
5x + 5y + 2z = 69 + 229
5x + 5y + 2z = 298… (iv)
now,
Multiply eq . (i) by 2 and then subtracting eq . (ii) we get
4x - 3z = 138 - 127
4x - 3z = 11 … (v)
Multiply eq . (ii) by 2 and then subtracting eq . (iii) we get
- 3x + 4z = 254 - 229
- 3x + 4z = 25 … (vi)
By solving eq . (v) and (vi) we get
z = 19
From eq . (iv) adding 3z we get
5x + 5y + 5z = 298 + 19 × 3 = 298 + 57 = 355

questions.q:
If A = (144)169 + (445)237 - (629)426, then what is the unit digit of A?

यदि A = (144)169 + (445)237 - (629)426, तो A का इकाई अंक क्या है?
questions.s:
Any power of 5 gives 5 as unit digit.

Even power of 4 gives 6 as unit digit and odd power of 4 gives 4 as unit digit.

Even power of 9 gives 1 as unit digit and odd power of 9 gives 9 as unit digit.

Therefore,

Unit digit of A = 4 + 5 - 1 = 9 - 1 = 8

questions.s:
Let x - 1 = 0

x = 1

putting value of x in 16x4 - px3 + 5x - 17 we get,

16 - p + 5 - 17

According to question,

4 - p = p/3

12 - 3p = p

4p = 12

questions_hin.q_hi: 10. 20 क्रमागत पूर्णांकों के समुच्चय का औसत 25.5 है। समुच्चय में सबसे छोटा पूर्णांक क्या है?

questions_hin.q_hi: 15. दो संभावित संख्याएँ 7 : 11 के अनुपात में हैं। यदि उनके वर्गों का योग 13770 है, तो दोनों संख्याओं के बीच का अंतर है:

questions_hin.q_hi:
If A = (144)169 + (445)237 - (629)426, then what is the unit digit of A?

यदि A = (144)169 + (445)237 - (629)426, तो A का इकाई अंक क्या है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Any power of 5 gives 5 as unit digit.

Even power of 4 gives 6 as unit digit and odd power of 4 gives 4 as unit digit.

Even power of 9 gives 1 as unit digit and odd power of 9 gives 9 as unit digit.

Therefore,

Unit digit of A = 4 + 5 - 1 = 9 - 1 = 8

questions_hin.q_hi:
When 16x4 - px3 + 5x - 17 is divided by (x - 1) leaves remainder which is equal to (p/3). Find the value of p.

जब 16x4 - px3 + 5x - 17 को (x - 1) से भाग दिया जाता है तो शेषफल (p/3) के बराबर होता है। p का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions_hin.s_hi:
Let x - 1 = 0

x = 1

putting value of x in 16x4 - px3 + 5x - 17 we get,

16 - p + 5 - 17

According to question,

4 - p = p/3

12 - 3p = p

4p = 12

p = 3

questions_hin.q_hi: 2. किसी भी प्राकृतिक संख्या n के लिए, 6n-5n का अंतिम अंक सदैव_________ होगा ।
questions_hin.s_hi:
2.(d) जैसा कि हम जानते हैं,
किसी भी प्राकृतिक संख्या n के लिए, 6n हमेशा 6 पर समाप्त होता है और 5n,  5 पर समाप्त होता है।

questions_hin.q_hi: 10. 1 से 150 के बीच कितनी संख्याएँ हैं जो 3 और 4 दोनों से विभाज्य हैं?
